message: XVatsim 1.0.4 is available. Download the update from X-Plane.org.
release_notes: Adds a persistent top-right overlay version chip that turns green when current and rotates amber version/UPDATE text when a newer build is available.
Replaces clipped footer update text with a dismissible update notice panel for automatic and manual update checks.
Runs one automatic update check per simulator/plugin session so a newly published manifest is not hidden by an older 24-hour check timestamp.
Added a weighted brain evidence ledger for terminal APP/DEP controller relevance.
Prevents one terminal-owner text mismatch from hiding a controller when VATSIM, radio, route, and source authority evidence support displaying it.
Includes FAA/NASR airport frequency evidence as low-weight context while treating FAA misses as neutral for VATSIM pseudo-frequency cases.
Reports score, votes, neutral facts, evidence families, confidence, and final display/hide action in controller relevance diagnostics.
